name: card_mul_sum_det_le
summary: Fourier analysis on k^m × k^m: with a primitive character ψ and M_s = A(true)ᵀπ(s)A(false), Σ_y E_v ψ(y·M_s·v) counts the y with y·M_s = 0, which are at least q when det M_s = 0. So the left side is at most Σ_y E_v Re Σ_s ψ(yM_s v)Θ(s). For y, v ≠ 0 this inner sum is an inner product of two tensors whose squared norms are |G| times the Θ-masses of the stabilisers in h (normalised characters for the contragredient side, the standard basis for the other), so it is ≤ √(qⁿ)·Y; the terms with y = 0 or v = 0 contribute at most 2ΣΘ.

steps.claim: Choose a primitive additive character ψ : k → ℂ (p: ψ is primitive).
Claim N: for an orthonormal family c : kⁿ → EuclideanSpace ℂ (kⁿ), an automorphism σ of the group GL_n(k) and a vector x ∈ kⁿ: Σ_{s ∈ G : σ(π(s))·x = x} Θ(s) = ‖Σ_{a∈G} c(σ(π(a))·x) ⊗ u(a)‖² / |G|.
steps.lean:
have N {c : (n → k) → EuclideanSpace ℂ (n → k)} (h : Orthonormal ℂ c) {σ : MulAut _} x :
      ∑ s with x = σ (π s) • x, Θ s = ‖∑ a, c (σ (π a) • x) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] u a‖ ^ 2 / card G
  rw [@norm_sq_eq_re_inner ℂ, inner_sum_sum_eq_card_mul (ofReal ∘ _)]
  simpa using sum_filter ..
  simp [*, orthonormal_iff_ite.1, apply_ite ofReal, mul_smul, eq_inv_smul_iff]
steps.typed_fact: ∑ s with x = σ (π s) • x, Θ s = ‖∑ a, c (σ (π a) • x) ⊗ₜ[ℂ] u a‖ ^ 2 / card G

steps.claim: Write the squared norm as Re⟨w, w⟩ and expand it with inner_sum_sum_eq_card_mul: the inner product of the terms at a and b depends only on a⁻¹b, so ‖w‖² = |G|·Σ_g f(g) with f(a⁻¹b) = ⟨c(σπ(a)x), c(σπ(b)x)⟩·Θ(a⁻¹b) (a side condition, that the inner product of the terms has this form, remains).
By orthonormality ⟨c(σπ(a)x), c(σπ(b)x)⟩ is 1 or 0 according as σπ(a)x = σπ(b)x; so |G|·Σ_g f(g) is |G| times the sum of Θ(s) over s with σπ(s)x = x, which is the claimed equation (a filtered sum).
The side condition: ⟨c(σπ(a)x) ⊗ u(a), c(σπ(b)x) ⊗ u(b)⟩ = [σπ(a)x = σπ(b)x]·⟨u(a), u(b)⟩ = [x = σπ(a⁻¹b)x]·Θ(a⁻¹b), by orthonormality of c, hu and the group law of σ∘π.
steps.lean: simp [*, orthonormal_iff_ite.1, apply_ite ofReal, mul_smul, eq_inv_smul_iff]

steps.claim: Let W(y, v, s) = ψ(y·A(true)ᵀ·π(s)·A(false)·v)·Θ(s) for y, v ∈ k^m (y as a row vector).
steps.lean: let W y v s := ψ (y ᵥ* (A true)ᵀ ᵥ* π s ᵥ* A false ⬝ᵥ v) * Θ s

steps.claim: Reduce the claim to three inequalities: (i) the left side is at most Σ_{y∈k^m} E_{v∈k^m} Re Σ_s W(y, v, s) (E the average); (ii) for all y, v: Re Σ_s W(y, v, s) ≤ [y = 0]·ΣΘ + [v = 0]·ΣΘ + r·Y; (iii) Σ_y E_v of the right side of (ii) is at most the right side of the claim.
steps.lean:
apply ((sum_mono fun y ↦ univ.expect_le_expect fun v _ ↦ (?_ : re (∑ s, W y v s) ≤
    ite (y = 0) (∑ s, Θ s) 0 + ite (v = 0) (∑ s, Θ s) 0 + r * Y)).trans _).trans'

steps.claim: In (i), sum the characters: Σ_y E_v ψ(y·M_s·v) (M_s = A(true)ᵀπ(s)A(false)) is the number of y with y·M_s = 0, by orthogonality of characters (sum_addChar_dotProduct); so (i) becomes q·Σ_{s : det M_s = 0} Θ(s) ≤ Σ_s Θ(s)·#{y : y·M_s = 0}.
steps.lean:
simp [W, -ite_mul, sum_comm, mul_sum, sum_filter, apply_ite, ↓← re_expect, ← sum_mul, ← mul_assoc,
    expect, NNRat.smul_def, sum_addChar_dotProduct p]

steps.claim: Compare termwise (Θ ≥ 0), and split every if-then-else in the open goals into its two cases (in (i): det M_s = 0 or not; in (ii): y = 0 or not, v = 0 or not).
If det M_s = 0, there is a nonzero row vector y₀ with y₀·M_s = 0.
Then t ↦ t·y₀ is an injective map from k into {y : y·M_s = 0}, so q = |k| ≤ #{y : y·M_s = 0}.

The case y ≠ 0, v ≠ 0 of (ii): by h for true at y and for false at v, Y + Y bounds the two Θ-masses of stabilisers; by N with the orthonormal family of normalised characters x ↦ (ζ ↦ ψ(−x·ζ)/r) (for the contragredient action on A(true)y) and with the standard basis (for the action on A(false)v), these masses are the squared norms of two tensors divided by |G|; by 2Re⟨X, Z⟩ ≤ ‖X‖² + ‖Z‖² (two_mul_le_add_sq, Cauchy–Schwarz) and inner_sum_sum_eq_card_mul with f = W(y, v, ·)/r, |G|·Re Σ_s W(y,v,s)/r is at most |G|·Y, i.e. Re Σ_s W(y, v, s) ≤ rY.
steps.lean:
on_goal -1 => apply flip id (add_le_add (h true y _) (h false v _))
                grw [@N fun x ↦ toLp 2 fun ζ ↦ ψ (-x ⬝ᵥ ζ) / r, N orthonormal_single, ← add_div,
    ← two_mul_le_add_sq, mul_assoc, ← @re_inner_le_norm ℂ, inner_sum_sum_eq_card_mul (W y v · / r)]

steps.claim: The remaining goals by computation: the normalised characters are orthonormal (orthogonality of characters, sum_addChar_dotProduct) and the inner products of step 10 are the W(y, v, s)/r; the cases of (ii) with y = 0 or v = 0 (|ψ| = 1 and Θ ≥ 0 bound Re Σ_s W by ΣΘ); and (iii): Σ_y E_v([y=0]ΣΘ + [v=0]ΣΘ + rY) = ΣΘ + ΣΘ + q^{|m|}·r·Y.
steps.lean:
all_goals simp [*, smul_vecMul, mul_nonneg, expect_add_distrib, NNRat.smul_def, W, r, add_nonneg,
    sum_nonneg', inner, field, vecMul_mulVec, ← Matrix.mul_assoc, orthonormal_iff_ite, two_mul,
    invTransposeGL, dotProduct_mulVec, div_mul_div_comm, ← map_neg_eq_conj, ← map_add_eq_mul,
    ← ofReal_mul, transposeGL,
    add_assoc, ← sum_div, neg_add_eq_sub, ← sub_dotProduct, sum_addChar_dotProduct, Units.smul_def]
